food.calculation_rule: meal_count_equivalent = 2 * day_count + 0.5 * night_count; total_cost = reference_price_cny * meal_count_equivalent * diner_count

tickets.calculation_rule: sum unique final-itinerary fixed adult ticket prices; category estimates are marked as experiment estimates; unpriceable POIs are not guessed

other.calculation_rule: removed by Budget Policy v2.0; personal shopping is excluded

buffer.calculation_rule: 10 percent contingency reserve applies only to destination-local basic cost; intercity rail is excluded
